When running castor with pollux, is it a bad idea to make him a dps as well? Would it be better to focus him on tank instead

it really depends on what you prefer -- even if you make castor a dps focus, he still puts out a LOT of shield bc his shield, like his other stats, scales off of damage amp, and making him a dps focuses on increasing his damage amp
so it's definitely not a bad idea, just depends on preference

i like playing him as tank because i am fond of never losing a single point of HP if i can manage it, but especially in longer runs of train mode castor ends up doing as much damage as pollux sometimes lol even without me meaning to
What build do you prefer for tank castor?

i've been running him with paradox covenant (focused on damage amp, keyflare regen, and aliemus regen when possible), with his signature wheel; the second wheel really depends on what you have, i managed to get his wheel to +12 from sheer dedication to saving up for it (reruns and such yknow) and so i've tested out a few different SSR damage amp wheels with him. right now though i bounce between Birth of a Soul, Annihilated Rebirth, Memory Spiral, or for SR wheels there's The Gaze of Isarawu, Witch's Wide-brimmed Hat, etc
ah okie thank you, I was doing similar just using cursed rabbit. I have never used paradox before lol.
yeah, if you have castor's wheel it makes the aliemus cap increase of the paradox covenant less of an issue haha, and the boost to his shield does a lot i think
